fields.label: Treatment
fields.options:
Contract Value Adjustment
Payment-side Deduction
Back-charge
fields.description: Contract Value Adjustment issues a ZATCA credit note (reduces VAT). Payment-side Deduction only reduces the receivable (no VAT effect). Choose per the ZATCA contracting guideline - this cannot be changed per-claim.

fields.label: Default Account
fields.description: Expense account debited when this deduction is applied. Leave empty to use the company default from Contracting Settings.

fields.label: Reverses Retention Proportionally
fields.description: If checked, the auto credit note also reverses retention on the credited amount. Usually OFF for damages (damages do not reduce works executed, so retention already withheld stays withheld).

fields.label: Description (English)
fields.description: Shown on the invoice print format next to this deduction.
